```artifact
## Decision Table Test Suite for U28_misc

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| Chemist/Lab Id exists | Display Chemist/Lab details |
| Chemist/Lab Id does not exist | Display "Chemist or Lab does not exist" error |
| Open Prescription Requests exist | Display "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete" error |
| Open Prescription Requests do not exist | Delete Chemist/Lab details |
| Symptom Code exists | Display Symptom details |
| Symptom Code does not exist | Display "Symptom does not exist" error |
| Patient Id generated | Display Patient profile |
| Patient Id not generated | Display error message |

```
